About

A cozy 3D platformer-collector for casual players 13+. Tansy, an original egg-shaped gardener, tends World 1 across four levels in order: Sunny Shelf, Stone Crossing, Islet Climb, and the Sulk Bulb. Pip the sprout follows and cheers when a level is cleared. Gentle, Breezy, and Bold change landing size and timing only. Art and audio are procedural. Progress, chosen tier, mute, and seen hints stay in localStorage on this device — no cookies, no account.

How to play / controls

Move with W A S D or arrow keys. Jump with 1 (or numpad 1); Space is a backup jump once a level is running. Dive with Shift or C. Plant with E. Pause with Esc. Start with Enter. Touch: left stick, jump and dive buttons, drag the right side to look.
